text: A cute floating island in the sea with a vegetable patch of red tomatoes(?) and a white bunny-like creature. It says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Let me tap the crops.
Harvested: coins 10->14, XP 3. Suddenly it's night - a day is only 30 sec? Now a panel at bottom: Sow / Water / Harvest, each 1 sec. Prompt says tap the farm to sow. Tapping the farm.
Watered, crops sprouted fast. Day 3 now. The bunny is called a Momo, it hopped to the field. Prompt: Tap a Momo. Tapping it.
Momo is smiling, 'Free time'. There's an Assign button and a pencil. Tip says tap pencil to pick tiles it looks after. So Momos are workers I assign to areas. Tapping pencil.
Sunset already. Selecting tiles: 0/4. The island looks like maybe a 2x2 grid. I'll tap the farm tile first.

Farm tile marked '1'. Momo now 'Working at Farm'. A text box tells me empty tiles can build a farm, mine, lumberyard or lab. The left empty tile is highlighted - I guess it wants me to build there. Tapping Got it.
Momo is working the farm on its own now (6 jobs), coins 22, +12/min. A mail icon bubble over Momo and red dot on Mailbox. I'll confirm the tile choice with the check mark, then look at the mail.
Mailbox opened: a letter from Momo 'What if we widened the field?'. Cute. Money is rolling in, 34 coins, farm skill went up to 1. Opening the letter.
Lovely letter on airmail paper from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. 'Let's research it' button. Sure!
It's 'On the research list' now. Let me check the Research menu to see what that means.

Big research tree: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins. Flasks probably come from a lab. There's a 'Build a research lab' button - handy shortcut. Tapping it.

Build menu popped up: Farm 10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. So I can't build the lab yet - need level 2 (I'm 59/90 XP). Not sure which tile it will go on. I'll build a second Farm for now.
It picked the right tile (where the tree was) on its own and is constructing - 2 sec. Fine, I didn't choose but OK. Waiting.
New farm built and already sprouting - but my nice tree is gone, a bit sad. 'Farm 0/1' at the bottom, maybe means no Momo assigned. I'll harvest it by hand.

Level 2! Now a hint says I can buy sea next to the island for 65 coins (dashed outline). I have 76. But I also want the research lab that just unlocked. I still have 2 empty tiles, so let me first check the lab price on the empty left tile.
Lab is 40, Lumberyard 80. 88 coins. Building the Research lab on the left tile.

Lab is building (4 sec). It says 'Research lab 0/1' - probably wants a worker. I only have one Momo and it's busy on the farms. Maybe I need to Hire another. Meanwhile the Mailbox still has a red dot, checking it.
Lab built - a cute cottage with a flask sign. There's an Experiment (3 sec) button. New letter: 'Maybe we could water less often'. Reading it.
Momo walked over to the lab by itself (Research lab 1/1) and is experimenting. But now both farms are ripe and nobody's harvesting. Adding Watering efficiency to the list too, then close.
A flask counter '1' appeared under the Day. Momo went back to farming. Little flags on the farm. I'll tap Experiment myself to make more flasks.
Tapping Experiment seems to have called Momo over to the lab, so the farms sit ripe again. One Momo isn't enough. Let me see what Hire offers. 96 coins.
Hire Momo costs 100, I have 104. Flasks at 2. Hiring a second Momo so one can farm and one can do research.
Hired 'Mochi'! Standing by the lab with free time. Let me try the Assign button this time to see how it differs from the pencil.
Level 3 popped (a toast faded quickly). Flasks = 3, Research has a red dot now - probably Field expansion is affordable. Assign mode says 'Tap a building for this Momo' - tapping the lab.
Mochi is now 'Working at Research lab'. Momo on farms. Nice division of labor. Now opening Research (red dot).
4 flasks, 44 coins: Field expansion now has 'Start research' (3 flasks + 20, 20s). Starting it.
Researching, 19 s. Curious about the 'Games' tab in research - what is that?
Ha, Games tab = 'Software: an island game studio' at Lv6 for 300 coins. Long-term goal. Mochi has a '...' thought bubble. Closing research and opening the mailbox (red dot).
Toast: 'Researched: Field expansion, Harvest crops +1'. Satisfying. Third letter: 'Let's give the soil something back'. Opening.

Letter proposes Bigger harvests (compost, crop rotation). Momo's letters are basically a guided research path - I like that framing. Accepting, then opening Research to see if I can afford Watering efficiency or Bigger harvests (5 flasks, 80 coins).
7 flasks, 112 coins, income now 100/min. Field expansion has levels (1/5). Two children unlocked: Watering efficiency (5) and Bigger harvests (8). Checking Watering efficiency.
Watering efficiency: wait after water -25%, 5 flasks + 40, 1m30s. Now I have 8 flasks so Bigger harvests is also possible. Checking that, sounds juicier.
Bigger harvests: crops +1, 8 flasks + 60, 2 min. 168 coins, 9 flasks. Starting it.
Build menu on the last empty tile. Mine needs 120 + 10 Wood, so wood comes first -> Lumberyard 80. But what's 'Special 0/1'? Peeking.
Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6), one slot. Nothing available yet. Going back and building the Lumberyard (172 coins).
Lumberyard going up. It'll need a worker (0/1). Checking hire price again with 140 coins.
Lumberyard is done (a tree with an axe stump), a Momo is already chopping - wood counter 2 appeared next to flasks. Not sure who left what. Hire price went up to 160; I have 170. Hiring a third Momo.
Third Momo 'Pomu'! And 'Next: City' went 0/4 -> 1/4, so maybe City means population/Momos? Assigning Pomu to the Lumberyard.
'Another Momo works here' - the lumberyard is already taken. I don't know who's where now; nobody seems to be at the lab. Trying the lab for Pomu.

Hmm, tapping the lab selected Mochi (who stands there) instead of assigning Pomu. Mochi covers tiles 1=lab and 2=lumberyard, bouncing between them. I lost track of Pomu - probably helping on the farm. A bit confusing who is doing what. Moving on: buying the sea plot for 65 (I have 96).
Bought the sea plot - a new grassy tile rose up with a flowering bush. Nice. Next plot shows 85. 12 flasks piling up, 85 coins. Spending flasks in Research.
Level 4 now (School landmark should be open). Bigger harvests still researching 11s - seems one at a time. Peeking at the Lumber tab.
Sharp axes needs 'Lumber mastery Lv2' (in red) - not sure how to get mastery, maybe the Momo's skill level? Back to Farm: start Watering efficiency.
Bigger harvests done, Greenhouse and Seed selection unlocked. 16 flasks, 189 coins, 10 wood. Starting Watering efficiency, then I can afford a Mine (120 + 10 wood) on the new tile!
Build menu for the new tile. Mine is affordable now (215 coins, 12 wood). Building the Mine.
Mine under construction (7 sec), cost 120 coins + 10 wood. Reading the new mail while it builds.
Mine done - a rocky hill with a cart and lantern, very charming. 'Dig 4 sec' button. Mochi wrote me too now: 'Let's grow the next trees first'. Reading.
Mochi proposes Tree nursery. Each Momo writes about their own job - sweet touch. A stone counter appeared too. Accepting and then trying to hire a miner.
Hire is 260 now (shown in red), I have 255. Waiting a moment for coins to tick in.
Fourth Momo 'Mugi'. City counter stayed 1/4, so it's not population. Assigning Mugi to the Mine.
Mugi is 'On the way: Mine'. Income 248/min. Still wondering what 'Next: City 1/4' means - tapping it.

Aha, the City goal checklist: Land 5/9, Momo 4/3 done, Research levels 2/3, Value produced 1.1K/1.5K -> 'Become a City!'. Now I have a clear target. Wish I'd tapped this earlier. Buying more land (85, I have 169).
City goal 2/4 now - research levels must have hit 3. Tapping the price tag didn't buy; tapping the dashed plot itself twice.
Second land plot bought (6/9). Island is growing in an L shape. Quickly putting a farm on the new tile.
Building a Farm on the new plot. Time is nearly up - I'd definitely keep going to reach City.
New farm built on the new plot. Mugi the miner already wrote: 'Green streaks in the rock' - copper? Love that each new worker writes about their job. Out of time.
